steps.title: Fix the offset computation in paginate()
steps.detail: Use (page - 1) * per_page when computing the offset.

steps.title: Add regression tests for the last page
steps.detail: Cover 21 rows with per_page=10, pages 1 to 3.

risks.description: Clients may rely on the old zero-based behaviour.
risks.mitigation: Check API docs and existing callers.

review_security.rationale: The pagination helper trusts a client-supplied per_page without an upper bound.

findings.title: Unbounded per_page allows resource exhaustion
findings.description: paginate() uses per_page as given; a request with per_page=10000000 loads the whole table into memory.
findings.suggested_fix: Clamp per_page to a configured maximum such as 100.

arbiter.rationale: One security finding is upheld; the style finding is a duplicate of an existing lint rule.

rulings.reason: Reproducible; the bound is missing on the only public entry point.

required_changes.description: Clamp per_page to a configured maximum and add a test.

arbiter.pr_summary: One blocking issue remains: per_page is unbounded (src/api/items.rs). Everything else looks good.
